f8fbfe5fa27cdc98bf8c07cb8031ef6e9b17e1f4.translatedText: These 26 items are all declared and read at startup, with no dynamic parameter update callback\.`maxGroundLift` and `noDataBlockSkipNum` currently do not affect the result because the switch is off;`clearingDis` are used by events and can be overridden by messages, and changes to their variables cannot be determined solely from the startup parameter table\.
